description: THE FREE TIER — what anyone gets free on Rokha each day, read from the one definition the gates enforce: a daily allowance in fuel units sized for a small build session with Rokha (≈ 15 questions' worth) plus 3 free runs of any public rig, one budget per person across the site, X and Telegram; the streak (every consecutive active day +10%, to 2× after 10 days); the free publish doors (2 MCP listings · 5 published rigs · 1 agent per claimed page); and the one way to pay Rokha (the Studio, $249 a month). Resets 00:00 UTC. Public, no login. REST twin: GET /api/free-tier (signed in: GET /api/free-tier/me shows your streak and runs left)
